# licensee

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:licensee`](gmeow-licensee.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/licensee>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/rights`](../../slices/rights.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The party receiving a licence ([odrl:assignee](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assignee)). A specialisation of [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md). Absent on an open / public licence offered to everyone.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to name the party receiving a licence (the [odrl:assignee](http://www.w3.org/ns/odrl/2/assignee)) when a grant is to a specific agent — the licence-scoped specialisation of [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md).

### Avoid when

- Avoid setting it for an open public licence offered to everyone (leave it absent) and avoid minting a separate receiving-party model; this specialises [`gmeow:hasParty`](gmeow-hasParty.md).

### How to use

- Add one or more [`gmeow:licensee`](gmeow-licensee.md) agents to a [`License`](../classes/gmeow-License.md) (non-functional) for a party-specific grant; omit it for a public CC/open-source offer that anyone may accept.

### Examples

- ex:enterpriseLicense [`gmeow:licensee`](gmeow-licensee.md) ex:acmeCorp.
